name: Shabbethai
bio: Shabbethai the Levite, along with Meshullam, assisted Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahaziah son of Tikvah in the months-long process of identifying every Israelite who had married a foreign wife after Ezra's return (Ezra 10:15-17). He later helped explain the Law to the people when Ezra read it publicly after the wall's completion (Nehemiah 8:7).
